name: k10-hub
description: K10 Hub — Unified full-stack platform for the UNIHIKER K10

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
